# opsolete_runner (Resource)

A runner: registered in a pool, with the token it starts with (OPS_RUNNER_TOKEN), e.g. for the Helm chart's secret. Runs of a project go only to runners of its pool. Deleting it revokes the token at once.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A runner for the production pool; its token goes into the Helm chart's secret.
resource "opsolete_runner" "prd" {
  name = "k8s-prd"
  pool = "prd"
}

output "runner_token" {
  value     = opsolete_runner.prd.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 2–63 lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

### Optional

- `pool` (String) It gets the runs of projects that use this pool. Default: `default`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Its token. Leave it out and Opsolete creates one (kept in Terraform's state: keep that encrypted); or set one from a secret store (at least 32 characters, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by name or id; its token isn't returned
terraform import opsolete_runner.prd k8s-prd
```
